assets.name: idle
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production mobile companion avatar, a single transparent PNG, square 1024x1024.
Reference image: the attached blue-haired whale-maid community character is the visual reference for DeepSeek whale girl, not an edit target. Create a polished fresh illustration inspired by its recognizable blue-gradient hair, small whale-fin side ears, one ahoge, cream lace headband, navy-and-cream maid outfit and small blue bow. For the Huixue Lab app's companion "小夜". Preserve this recognizability; no logos, text or watermarks.
Subject: one clearly adult feminine anime companion in a soft super-deformed chibi portrait, large head and small clothed shoulders/upper torso. Close, centered bust portrait filling 85% of square; entire hair/headband/ears and shoulders safely within frame with 7% empty margins. Front-facing, head upright. Her face is the main focus and large enough to read at 32px. Long blue hair frames shoulders symmetrically, navy-to-periwinkle gradients, teal-blue eyes. Small cream ruffles and a teal neck ribbon, subtle brass accent. Refined warm dark-blue outlines, soft cel shading, controlled highlights, beautiful hand-drawn anime illustration, not 3D.
Expression: IDLE / gently sleepy: half-lidded eyes looking at viewer, very slight relaxed smile, calm reassuring companion, not sad. No gesture, no props. Palette: dusty navy #3C5F96, periwinkle #79A5D7, cream #F7F4EF, small muted teal #3D5A4A details. Only character, genuinely transparent background, no colored panel, no floor, no cast shadow outside silhouette. No extra limbs, no floating accessories, no words, no emoji.

assets.name: launcher
assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: single Android adaptive launcher foreground mark, transparent square PNG 1024x1024.
Create an elegant illustrated logo for the Chinese wellness app "回血实验室". The ONLY symbol is the Chinese character 回, rendered geometrically as TWO nested rounded square cream outline loops, a broad outer rounded square and smaller inner rounded square, clearly recognizable as 回. One small muted ochre circular dot rests just outside the outer loop near its upper-right corner. No other letters or words. Keep the shape bold and extremely simple so it reads at 48px.
Style: soft hand-painted enamel, smooth cream #F7F4EF shapes with subtle warm shading, restrained muted brass dot #B0842E, tiny navy accent only if needed for dimensional separation, absolutely no noisy texture. Straight-on flat centered geometry, no perspective tilt. The monogram fills 76% of the square with generous even empty safe margins. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background, transparent holes between loops, no colored tile, no background, no ground or external shadow, no watermark. This will be placed onto a dark forest-green adaptive icon background by the app. Produce one icon only, not a presentation board.
